scope: All original GC/plasmablast/NKT/ILC/MAIT labels plus source fine groups selected by prior review; not the whole 63-label second pass.
T_complex: CD3D/CD3E/CD3G >=2 and all3 detection separately; CD247 is measured but not sufficient for T identity.
gamma_joint: T-complex >=2 AND TRDC AND (TRGC1 or TRGC2), plus stricter all3 CD3 version; RNA review only, not confirmed gamma-delta identity.
plasma_joint: at least2 of JCHAIN (explicit IGJ fallback), MZB1, SDC1 in same cell; all feature axes must be available.
marker_alias: JCHAIN uses IGJ only when canonical JCHAIN absent; resolution is recorded explicitly, never summed with JCHAIN.
missing_feature: Unavailable component makes its joint program NA, not zero.
thresholds: No calibrated annotation accuracy or disease tests; actual detection only.
